Built **Verdant Keep**, a complete, playable tower defense game in `index.html`.

Choose a defense, place it on a glowing build slot, then begin a wave. Rangers fire rapid arrows, Moonwells deal splash magic damage, and Stone Mortars launch heavy siege shots. Enemies have different armor types, so choosing the right mix matters. Earn gold between waves to build or upgrade towers, and sell defenses for a partial refund.

The game includes 10 waves, speed and pause controls, lives and gold, tower targeting and range indicators, and a reset button. It’s responsive for mobile and desktop. I checked the game in-browser and verified that placing a tower and starting a wave work.

To play locally, serve the project directory with `python3 -m http.server 3002` and open `http://localhost:3002`.
